notes.title: Patch 1.0.11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/c61186c06e15ef4d809ac4224929d29626a79227.png[/img]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
All usual and elite enemies on Levels 1-5 are slightly weaker now.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Russian has been added in test mode. The second class (Brute) is currently not available in Russian.
[Добавлен русский язык в тестовом режиме. Второй класс (Брут) недоступен из-за особенностей языка] 

[h3]Controls[/h3]
Tile placement feels better now (better drag-and-drop accuracy). Although an alternative controls is still recommended if you prefer to play in the Cursed/Doomed mode (Options >> Alternative Controls).

Removed the delay for the "clean board" mechanic.

[h3]Added words[/h3]
- toon(-s)
- roc(-s)
- brining

[h3]Starting decks[/h3]
You can't get two letters "C" in the starting deck from now on.

[h3]Other[/h3]
Added a couple of tips for players to prevent common mistakes and misunderstanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10

Fixed a visual bug with the Blade of Limited Infinity. After the 3rd strike, if you placed a valid word on the Attack board, you could not see the value of this word.

Level 2 final boss now has less HP. This boss also has less HP during challenges.

[Other]

notes.title: ​⚔️️​ Words Can Kill: Demo Update
notes.content:
Several players during the Next Fest reported that they still don't like controls in the game. So I added an alternative way to place tiles on the board for players who prefer the Cursed (or Doomed) mode. It can be activated through the menu (ESC -> Options).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/0f0d7b3b2a1da05a458188461ba8fcc0e811e5cd.png[/img]

1. You need to click the target board first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/8c4b206c1b41292370c6ab5011c38cbda8c4ffc2.png[/img]

2. Then click tiles you want to add.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/13a2a4465d58acefb8dafdee8ba8af6d73d27721.png[/img]

3. Then click an Attack (or Block) button if you've built a valid word on the target board. Or you can click an empty green square to finish entering the word.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/6ba60da5839f658fac14258ee52cf3643a255b29.png[/img]

Aside from that the tips for the new players were added, UI on the map was improved, a couple of annoying music tracks were changed.

I plan to add some new items and balance the 3rd class before the release. The game will be released after the final testing as soon as possible (hope, in July).

notes.title: Pre-Release Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]Demo was updated[/h3]
- You can try magic effect tiles and new no-hints modes in the demo right now.
- Tile placement feels better now.
- If you hover over a tile in the Gifted (hinted) mode you can see possible words containing this tile.
- Balance was slightly reworked (some items will be reworked for the no-hints modes soon). Remember, the demo is 2/3 of the run on the [i]easiest[/i] difficulty. So if you feel it's too easy try to play the game in the Doomed mode or wait for the full release.
- Some visual effects were added.
- You can finish your turn by pressing Space and cancel the last action by pressing right mouse button.
- I want to add the word definitions and the possibility to rearrange tiles on the board soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/c0d832d63f08619b890eb307af8768fcda909d88.png[/img]

[h3]Need help[/h3]
English is not my native language so I ask community to help me with some [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1732090/discussions/0/3193621324032684859/]in-game descriptions[/url].
Please report me about any grammatical errors and bugs you encounter during your play.

[h3]Sorry for the delay[/h3]
Words Can Kill is a solo developed game. I planned to release it before the end of March. But it was hard to work last month because I was totally frustrated by last political events. Although I'm against the war in Ukraine, as a Russian citizen I'm under economical sanctions now.
I wanted to add some new music tracks for the game, because some of the current tracks feel very repetitive. But I cannot purchase licenses for music and sounds from international stores because there is no available payment option for my country. I still hope Steam will continue to work with Russian indie developers but there is too much uncertainty now.

notes.title: New classes and magic effect tiles
notes.content:
Words Can Kill is on the final stages of the development. All enemies and boss battles are ready now.

[b]Two new classes were added[/b]: Brute and Keymaster. The default character was currently named Pioneer. You can propose your own names for the classes in the comments.
- [b]Brute[/b] starts his path with the deck full of 2-letter tiles. Once per turn he can split a 2-letter tile into two 1-letter tiles.
- [b]Keymaster[/b] collects keys to draw more tiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/e1fdb526f68d16acc83c05063f70b2ef13955e09.png[/img]

It is possible now to add [b]magic effects[/b] to some tiles in the forge or to get tiles with effects as a reward after battles.
There are some examples of effects:
[i]+2 points on the Attack board
+2 points on the Defense board
Restore 1 health if this tile is used to spell a word
Gains 1 point each time it’s used to spell a word
+2 points if this is the first tile of a word
+2 points in the middle of a word[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/53fe76c2e185610ce26ef9b2df8d0521734f3512.png[/img]

The player can choose one of the [b]3 modes[/b]: Gifted (with hints), Cursed (without hints, but with addittional bonuses), Doomed (no hints, no bonuses).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/d037055efb88c6456c95b6e3b0201ccea528a61a.png[/img]

The demo will be updated at the end of February. The full release is planned for the middle of March.

notes.title: Big controls rework
notes.content:
Several players reported that the control system in the game was clunky and more suitable for mobile devices.  So time has come to change the way controls works in Words Can Kill.

- Now you can click a tile -> click a destination point in addition to the old drag&drop system.

- You can insert a tile from your hand between the tiles on the board until any meaningful action (an attack, a block, the end of turn).

- You can undo your previous action by pressing the right mouse button (RMB).

- You can undo all your actions by pressing the "X" button.

Smoothness of the tile placement is one of the future tasks.

Fill free to leave your feedback in the comments or in the Community hub.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150888/44ad58a7dd549e04c215df2637803136ec97b971.png[/img]
